name: cancel-report-request
title: Cancel report request stops a slow AI draft request

issue.title: Cancel report request does nothing while an AI draft is being requested
issue.expected: Cancel report request stops waiting at once and the status bar says the request was cancelled (README promise).
issue.actual: The click is ignored until the provider answers.
issue.dt_test: tests/desktop/test_ui.py: patch the report provider so the request blocks on a threading.Event, call draft_report, click the 'Cancel report request' button while busy() is true, and assert the status bar says the request was cancelled and a late reply is discarded.
suspected: dt/ui.py: finalise_tab wires 'Cancel report request' through MainWindow.button -> run_action, which returns while busy()
